purpose: Re-test the separated TES/substrate joint c2 comparison while allowing the shared effective series inductance L to float continuously from the SQUID-washer-scale 0.1 nH through the approximately 1.25 nH ISAS-B10 input-coil scale.

L_H.semantics: shared effective TES-current-path series inductance; diagnostic interval spanning approximately 0.1 nH to 1.3 nH so the fit can choose between the washer-scale and published ISAS-B10 input-coil-scale values without allowing the historical microhenry drift

C_tes_material_multiplier.semantics: TES-local heat capacity after separating the substrate/membrane node; referenced to the bare-bilayer material estimate but still treated as an effective local quantity

C_substrate_J_per_K.semantics: one symmetric local Si/substrate-membrane heat-capacity node per TES; the range includes the historical PoST C_tes scale but that historical number is not documented as an explicit silicon calorimetry result

G_tes_substrate_over_G_substrate_bath.semantics: shared conductance partition ratio. For each day G_tes-substrate and G_substrate-bath are derived so their series-equivalent conductance equals the existing G_tes-bath exactly.

guardrail: This diagnostic treats L as the effective series inductance in the TES-current branch of the reduced noise model, not as a direct measurement of SQUID washer self-inductance. The interval deliberately spans 0.1-1.3 nH and excludes the historical approximately 0.9 microhenry drift that produced visually good but physically inconsistent early fits. All other separated-substrate freedoms are retained so the test asks whether a physically plausible L interval can rescue c2=0.
